doctrine: A verifier bug fixed locally is a bug that can recur. A class is extinct only when a PERMANENT, RUNNING mutant in a WIRED gate would catch its recurrence. Every entry below names the incident it memorializes, the gate that carries the mutant, the exact mutant label, and the tier that runs that gate.

classes.title: TDZ: a lane rule imported dynamically below its first use
classes.incident: script/m29/verify-wave-execution.ts — the per-language relevance rule was a dynamic import placed below its first use; the ReferenceError landed in the staleness catch and every wave leg silently read stale.
classes.publicProbe: a doctored gate source carrying a relative dynamic import below its first use is flagged by importOrderFindings

classes.title: Silent capability cap: a hardcoded step status overriding recorded evidence
classes.incident: script/m29/verify-wave-protocol.ts — S5 was hardcoded "blocked", which capped fully-verified languages at I1 even with both legs green on disk. The cap lied downward with no blocker recorded.
classes.publicProbe: a hardcoded blocked S5 caps a fully-evidenced language below its true cap

classes.title: Self-staling byte-gated doc: a volatile pin copied into a byte-compared artifact
classes.incident: script/m53/verify-closure.ts — a byte-gated doc that embeds the live HEAD (or a wall-clock timestamp) re-stales on the very commit that records it, so the drift gate can never go green. The receipt declares the invariant in prose; this class makes it enforceable.
classes.mutantLabel: byte-gated doc embedding the live HEAD re-stales
classes.publicProbe: a byte-gated doc carrying the live HEAD is caught by the volatile-pin rule

classes.title: Concurrent clobber: two gate processes writing the same evidence record
classes.incident: M61.V2 — concurrent gate runs interleaved on one evidence file; the lock was added so a second writer refuses loudly instead of silently stealing or overwriting.
classes.publicProbe: a lock site that steals a stale lock instead of refusing is caught

classes.title: Unsealed evidence trust: a gate believing a clobbered or hand-edited record
classes.incident: M61.V1 — evidence JSONs were written and read as bare JSON, so a clobbered, half-written, or hand-edited record was believed by every downstream gate.
classes.publicProbe: a verifier that accepts a tampered record is caught

classes.title: On-demand gate rot: a gate wired into no tier rots silently, then breaks an unrelated closure
classes.incident: M61.V4 — the m26 on-demand gates (cross-language hover, graph docs, polyglot e2e) rotted while the 40-gate ladder stayed green; when the m29 closure spawned the m26 bar it went red, and the lane ladder never listed the M61 gates so verify-sealing's exit-1 regression was invisible. A gate in no tier is a gate nobody runs.
classes.publicProbe: a gate wired into no execution tier and not declared on-demand stops failing G5
